name: Querit
summary: Web search API for AI agents, with highlights, optional full page text and code and finance verticals.

api_key.description: A Querit API key (querit.ai dashboard). Sent as a Bearer token.

notes: HTTP 429 means the rate limit was hit; back off exponentially. Limits and prices are on the pricing page and per plan.
Contents and Monitors endpoints exist but have no public reference page, so they are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Search the web
endpoints.summary: Web results with snippets or highlights, optionally full body text, with site, time, country, language and vertical filters.

count.description: Maximum results; server default when omitted.

highlights.description: true, or {query, maxCharacters (100 to 8000)}, for query-focused passages.

needContent.description: Put each result's body text in its sentence array; default false.

contentMaxChars.description: Per-result body text cap, 1 to 1,000,000; omitted or null means no cap.

filters.description: sites {include, exclude}, timeRange {date: d[n] | w[n] | m[n] | y[n] | YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD}, geo {countries {include}}, languages {include}, vertical (code or finance), resourceTags {include: qa, github; code vertical only}.

rank.description: {preference: relevance | freshness}; not with vertical code.

notes: The response may carry a cost object (USD); its absence means unknown, not free.
Body text (needContent) is not covered by the monthly free search quota.
chunksPerDoc is deprecated in favor of highlights and is left out.
